title: Strength test.
officialText:
A strength test shall be the average of the strengths of two 6 inch by 12 inch (152 mm by 3048
mm) or two 4 inch by 8 inch (102 mm by 203mm) cylinders made from the same sample of concrete and tested at 28 days
or at the test age designated for the determination of f' . Consideration shall be given specifying an f ' at 56 days or later for
c c
concrete utilizing pozzolans in the mix proportions. At the discretion of the registered design professional of record or the
approved agency performing the testing, additional pairs of test cylinders may be taken at the time of sampling for testing at
a later date. The additional cylinders may be tested at a later date should the strength at the specified date not meet the
required f' .
